question: Where should the breath and awareness be directed during this offering posture?
premises: The breath is directed upward again and again.
The direction continues to the end of the twelve, in the fire of awareness, from the moon circle.
inference: The ritual posture is coordinated with an upward breath movement rising from the moon circle into the fire of awareness up to the twelvefold limit.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the twelvefold limit is technical and context-dependent.
plain_english: One should place the spoon below, directing the breath upward and upward until the end of the twelve, into the fire of awareness, from the moon circle.
